citations.title: Henry A. Fernandez

sentences.text: Henry A. Fernandez has served as chief executive officer of MSCI Inc. since 1998 and as a director and chairman of its board since 2007, and he was also president from 1998 to 2017.
He became head of the MSCI business in 1996 and led the company through its 2007 IPO as it separated from Morgan Stanley.

Before that he was a managing director at Morgan Stanley, where he worked from 1983 to 1991 and from 1994 to 2007 in emerging markets product strategy, equity derivative sales and trading, mergers and acquisitions, corporate finance and mortgage finance.

sentences.quote: Mr. Fernandez holds a BA degree in economics from Georgetown University and an MBA from Stanford University, and he pursued doctoral studies in economics at Princeton University.

citations.title: Leadership Change at MSCI: President Pettit Retires, CEO Fernandez Consolidates Power

sentences.quote: Pettit, who joined MSCI in 2000 and assumed the President role in 2017, ceased serving as COO effective November 12, 2025, but will remain President and a Director until March 1, 2026.
sentences.text: In November 2025 MSCI announced the retirement of President and Chief Operating Officer C.D. Baer Pettit after more than 25 years, with Chairman and CEO Henry A. Fernandez reassuming the President title on March 1, 2026 and the board shrinking from twelve to eleven members; Pettit ceased as COO on November 12, 2025 and stayed on as an adviser into the third quarter of 2026.
Internal promotions followed: Alvise Munari became Head of Client Segments and Jorge Mina, formerly Head of Analytics, became COO, also chairing MSCI's AI Transformation Center of Excellence.

In June 2026 Kashi Kakarla joined as Chief Technology Officer and Head of Product Engineering, reporting to Fernandez, opening a Silicon Valley office, alongside a new board Technology and Data Committee.
